value: Across all participants, greater dissociation severity was associated with greater grey matter volume in the right middle frontal gyrus.

The observed positive correlation between brain volume and dissociation severity may be related to excessive downregulation of emotional arousal by detachment in patients suffering from dissociative subtype PTSD.
